integrity: A complete analytical proof and a standalone finite consistency checker are supplied; there is no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to full one-block zip shifts induced by finite surjections; it does not classify higher-block, constrained, sofic or arbitrary finite-to-one local homeomorphisms. Finite checks do not replace the proof. Further independent literature-priority checking is warranted.
title: Fixed-point inverse-degree classification of full one-block zip shifts
